craft_claim: Compelling dialogue operates primarily through subtext where characters pursue tactical objectives indirectly without stating literal feelings.

supporting_evidence.note: Prose shows that dialogue functions best when what is said serves as an oblique mask for what is felt.
Subtext aligns with dhvani where the unexpressed suggestion (vyangya artha) supersedes explicit denotation.

supporting_evidence.location: Garden swing conversation between Charu and Amal
supporting_evidence.note: Amal and Charu debate literature and poetry while the actual exchange communicates illicit romantic yearning.

scope: Dramatic dialogue across stage, screen, and fiction.
exceptions: Formal legal, military, or procedural exchanges where explicit clarity is mandated by the setting.
